#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a Team Meeting calendar event for next Wednesday (2026-08-05), 3-4 PM CST."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
import pytz

tz = pytz.timezone('Asia/Shanghai')  # local timezone (CST, UTC+8)
start = tz.localize(datetime(2026, 8, 5, 15, 0, 0))   # Wednesday 3:00 PM
end = tz.localize(datetime(2026, 8, 5, 16, 0, 0))     # Wednesday 4:00 PM
dtstamp = datetime.now(pytz.UTC)
uid = f'{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill'

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync meeting. (Scheduled for Wednesday, August 5, 2026, 3:00-4:00 PM CST)
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
TRANSP:OPAQUE
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon!
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open('team_meeting.ics', 'w', newline='\r\n') as f:
    f.write(ics)

print('Created team_meeting.ics')
print(f'Event: Team Meeting')
print(f'Start: {start}')
print(f'End:   {end}')
print(f'UID:   {uid}')
EOF
